title: 롤플레이 (11~13번)
intro: OPIc 11~13번은 한 상황이 질문하기(11번) → 문제 해결(12번) → 관련 경험(13번)으로 이어지는 롤플레이 구간입니다. 상대 대답 없이 혼자 말하므로 음성 메시지를 남기듯 한 번에 쭉 이어 말하면 됩니다. 상황은 늘 내 페르소나로 바꿔 생각하세요: 회사 동기 Minji와의 주말 영화 약속, 대전에 사시는 부모님과의 제주 여행, 작년 여름 오사카 여행처럼 이미 준비한 이야기를 그대로 재활용하면 훨씬 자연스럽습니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장('Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.') → 내 상황 한 줄(회사 동기 Minji와 / 부모님과) → 질문 3~4개 또는 문제 설명 + 대안 2개 → 마무리 문장('Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks!')
11번(질문하기)은 First / Also / And one more thing 으로 질문을 3~4개 이상 이어 갑니다. 시간·가격·할인·좌석·포함 사항 중에서 고르세요.
12번(문제 해결)은 'I'm afraid there's a problem.' → 무슨 일이 생겼는지 한두 문장 → 'Is it possible to ~? / If not, could I ~?' 로 대안 2개 이상 → 'Please call me back.' 으로 끝냅니다.
13번(경험)은 일반 경험 문제와 같습니다. 언제 → 무슨 일 → 내가 한 행동 → 결과·느낀 점을 과거시제로 말하고, 12번과 비슷한 소재(친구와의 약속, 여행 예약)를 고르면 준비가 쉽습니다.

expressions.en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the movie this weekend.
expressions.ko: 안녕하세요, 이번 주말 영화 때문에 전화드렸어요.
expressions.note: 11번 만능 시작 문장. about 뒤만 바꾸기

expressions.en: How much is it per person?
expressions.note: per person / for two people 로 바꿔 쓰기
Is ~ included? 로 포함 사항 묻기

expressions.en: Is it possible to change the date?
expressions.note: Is it possible to + 동사원형 = 대안 제시

expressions.en: Could you call me back at this number?
My coworker just told me she can't make it.
expressions.ko: 회사 동료가 방금 못 온다고 했어요.
expressions.note: make it = (약속에) 가다, 시간 맞춰 오다

expressions.en: I was wondering if you have any discounts.
expressions.note: I was wondering if ~ = 공손하게 묻기

expressions.en: If that's not possible, could I get a refund instead?
expressions.ko: 그게 안 되면 대신 환불받을 수 있을까요?
expressions.note: 두 번째 대안을 붙이는 연결 문장

expressions.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could help me out.
Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks!
expressions.ko: 네, 여쭤보고 싶은 건 그게 다예요. 감사합니다!

expressions.en: Something came up at work at the last minute.
expressions.note: 직장인 롤플레이 단골 이유. come up = (일이) 생기다

expressions.en: It turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
expressions.note: 13번 경험 답의 반전 마무리에 좋은 관용 표현

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to see a movie with a friend this weekend. Call the movie theater and ask three or four questions about the movie.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 이번 주말에 친구와 영화를 보려고 합니다. 영화관에 전화해서 영화에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.' → 회사 동기 Minji와 볼 거라는 상황 한 줄 → 질문 3~4개(시간·가격·할인·좌석) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
질문마다 First / Also / And one more thing 을 붙이면 개수가 분명하게 들립니다.
IH 이상은 '평일 내내 야근해서 저녁 상영이 좋다', '팝콘 콤보'처럼 직장인 내 상황에 맞춘 질문을 하나 더 넣으세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie. My coworker Minji and I want to see it this Saturday. I have a few questions. First, what time does it start on Saturday evening? Also, how much are the tickets for two people? Do you have any discounts for members? And one more thing, are there any seats left in the middle? We don't like sitting too close to the screen. Okay, thank you so much. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Bye!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie that just came out. My coworker Minji and I are planning to see it this Saturday, so I have a few questions. First of all, what time are the shows on Saturday? We usually sleep in on weekends, so an evening show would be perfect for us. Also, how much are the tickets for two people? I have a membership card for your theater, so I was wondering if I can get a discount. And are there any seats left in the middle? We don't really like sitting too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, do you sell popcorn and drink combos? Minji loves caramel popcorn, and I want to treat her because she helped me a lot with a big report this week. Okay, that sounds great. Thank you so much for your help. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Have a good one!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie that just came out this week. My coworker Minji and I have been dying to see it, and since we finally wrapped up a huge campaign at work, we decided to treat ourselves this Saturday. So I have a few questions, if you don't mind. First of all, what time are the evening shows on Saturday? Honestly, we've been working late all week, so we're planning to sleep in, and anything after six would be perfect. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? I've got a membership card for your theater, so I was wondering if there's any kind of discount I can use. And are there still any good seats left in the middle? We always end up with a sore neck when we sit too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, do you have popcorn and drink combos? Minji is a huge fan of caramel popcorn, and I'd love to surprise her, because she really saved me with a report this week. Lastly, is there parking nearby, or should we just take the subway? Okay, that's really helpful. Thanks a lot for your time. So yeah, that's pretty much everything I wanted to ask. Have a great day!

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to go on a trip during your vacation. Call a travel agency and ask three or four questions about a trip package you are interested in.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 휴가 때 여행을 가려고 합니다. 여행사에 전화해서 관심 있는 여행 패키지에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling about your ~ package.' → 여름휴가에 대전 부모님을 모시고 제주에 간다는 상황 한 줄 → 질문 3~4개(기간·가격·포함 사항·출발 공항) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
가격(How much ~ per person?), 포함 사항(Is ~ included?), 일정(How long ~?), 취소(Can I cancel ~?)는 어느 여행 상품에도 통하는 질문입니다.
AL은 '부모님이 많이 걷기 힘들다', '연차를 3일밖에 못 쓴다'처럼 질문의 이유를 붙여 자연스럽게 길이를 늘리세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about your Jeju Island package. I want to take my parents on a trip during my summer vacation. I have a few questions. First, how long is the trip, and how much is it per person? Also, are the flights and the hotel included? My parents live in Daejeon, so can we fly from Cheongju Airport? And one more thing, are meals included in the price? Okay, thank you. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the Jeju Island package on your website. I'm planning a trip with my parents during my summer vacation in August, so I have a few questions. First of all, how long is the trip, and how much does it cost per person? I can only take three days off from work, so a short trip would be best. Also, are the flights and the hotel included in the price? My parents live in Daejeon and I live in Seoul, so I was wondering if we can fly from different airports. And is there a tour guide, or do we travel on our own? My parents don't like walking too much, so a tour bus would be really nice. Oh, and one more thing, can I cancel the trip if something comes up at work? Okay, thanks a lot. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.
answers.AL: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the three-day Jeju Island package I saw on your website. My parents have been talking about going back to Jeju for years, so I finally decided to take them during my summer vacation in August. I have a few questions, if that's okay. First of all, how much is the package per person, and what exactly does it include? Since I can only take three days off, I'd love something with the flights, hotel and rental car all set up in advance. Also, my parents live in Daejeon while I live in Seoul, so I was wondering if we could fly out of different airports and just meet up in Jeju. And is the hotel close to the beach? My mom really wants a room with an ocean view, so if that costs a little extra, that's totally fine. Oh, and one more thing, what's your cancellation policy? Things at my company can get pretty hectic, and something could come up at the last minute. I'd hate to lose all that money. Okay, that's really helpful, thank you. So yeah, that's pretty much everything I wanted to know. I'll talk it over with my parents and call you back soon.

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You bought two movie tickets for this weekend, but your friend just told you that she can't come. Call the theater, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 이번 주말 영화표를 두 장 샀는데, 친구가 방금 못 온다고 했습니다. 영화관에 전화해서 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my tickets.' → 예매 정보(토요일 저녁, 2장) → 이유(Minji가 갑자기 주말 출근) → 대안 2~3개(일요일로 변경 / 한 장만 환불 / 다른 영화로 교환) → 'Please call me back.'
대안은 'Is it possible to ~? / If not, could I ~? / Or maybe I could ~.' 순서로 이어 말하면 깔끔합니다.
IH 이상은 예매 번호·전화번호를 남기고 감사 인사로 마무리해 실제 통화처럼 들리게 하세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my movie tickets. I bought two tickets for the action movie this Saturday at seven. But my coworker Minji just told me she can't come. She has to work this weekend. So is it possible to change the tickets to Sunday? If not, could I get a refund for one ticket? Or maybe I can change both tickets to next week. Please call me back at this number. Thank you. Yeah, that's it.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling because I'm afraid there's a problem with my tickets. I booked two tickets online for the new action movie this Saturday at seven p.m. But my coworker Minji just texted me and said she can't come. Our team has a big presentation on Monday, so she has to go into the office this weekend. I really don't want to waste the tickets, so I have a few ideas. First, is it possible to change both tickets to Sunday evening? I think she'll be free by then. If not, could I get a refund for just one ticket? Then I could watch it by myself. Or maybe I could exchange them for the same movie next Friday night. My booking number is in my email, so I can send it to you. Please call me back at this number. Thanks so much. Yeah, that's all.
answers.AL: Hi, I'm calling because I'm afraid there's a bit of a problem with my reservation. I booked two tickets online for the new action movie this Saturday at seven p.m., but my coworker Minji just called me and told me she can't make it. Something came up at work at the last minute, and our team leader asked her to finish a client report over the weekend. She felt terrible about it, and honestly, I was pretty disappointed too, because we'd been looking forward to it all week. Anyway, I was hoping you could help me out. First, would it be possible to move both tickets to Sunday evening instead? She said she'll probably be done by then. If that doesn't work, could I get a refund for just one of the tickets? I wouldn't mind watching it on my own. And if neither of those is possible, maybe I could exchange them for a show next Friday night, since I work from home on Fridays and I'll have more time. My booking number should be in the confirmation email, so I can read it to you whenever you need it. Please give me a call back at this number when you get a chance. I'd really appreciate it. So yeah, that's pretty much it. Thanks a lot!

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You booked a trip through a travel agency, but you just found out that your flight has been canceled. Call the travel agency, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 여행사를 통해 여행을 예약했는데, 방금 항공편이 취소된 것을 알게 됐습니다. 여행사에 전화해서 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my trip.' → 예약 정보(부모님과 제주 3일 패키지) → 문제(태풍으로 항공편 취소 문자) → 대안 2~3개(같은 날 다른 항공편 / 하루 미루고 호텔 연장 / 전액 환불) → 'Please call me back.'
직장인이라 휴가 날짜를 바꾸기 어렵다는 이유를 넣으면 대안의 순서가 자연스럽게 정해집니다.
AL은 'I totally understand it's not your fault, but ~' 처럼 상대를 배려하는 말을 넣어 세련되게 들리게 하세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm afraid there's a problem with my trip. I booked a three-day Jeju package with your agency for me and my parents. But I just got a text, and our flight was canceled because of the typhoon. So is it possible to get seats on a later flight the same day? If not, could we leave one day later? Or maybe I can just get a full refund. Please call me back at this number. Thank you. Yeah, that's all.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling about the Jeju trip I booked with your agency, and I'm afraid there's a problem. It's a three-day package for me and my parents, and we're supposed to leave this Thursday morning. But I just got a text from the airline, and it says our flight was canceled because of the typhoon. I can't really change my vacation dates because of work, so I have a few ideas. First, is it possible to put us on a later flight on the same day? Even an evening flight is okay. If not, could we leave on Friday instead and stay one more night at the hotel? I'm happy to pay a little extra for that. And if neither of those works, I think I'd like a full refund. Please call me back as soon as you can. Thanks a lot. Yeah, that's all.
answers.AL: Hi, I'm calling about the three-day Jeju package I booked with your agency, and I'm afraid we've run into a problem. The trip is for me and my parents, and we're supposed to fly out this Thursday morning. But about an hour ago I got a text from the airline saying our flight was canceled because of the typhoon. I totally understand it's not your fault, but I'm in a bit of a tough spot, because I already got my vacation approved at work and it's really hard to change the dates now. So here's what I was thinking. First, is there any chance you could get us on a later flight that same day? Even a late evening flight would be fine with us. If that's not possible, could we push everything back by one day and add an extra night at the hotel? I wouldn't mind paying a bit more for that. And if neither of those options works out, I guess I'd have to ask for a full refund, which would honestly be a shame, since my parents are so excited about this trip. Please give me a call back at this number as soon as you can. I'd really appreciate your help. So yeah, that's the situation. Thanks so much!

questions.en: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a plan canceled or changed at the last minute? Tell me what happened and how you handled it.
questions.ko: 상황은 여기까지입니다. 계획이 막판에 취소되거나 바뀐 적이 있나요? 무슨 일이 있었고 어떻게 대처했는지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Oh, that reminds me of ~.' → 언제·누구와(작년 봄, 대학 친구들과 부산 여행) → 무슨 일(태풍으로 KTX 취소) → 대처(내 아파트에서 영화 몰아보기, 2주 뒤 다시 감) → 'Yeah, that's ~.'
과거시제를 일관되게 쓰고, 마지막에 느낀 점(오히려 좋았다)을 한 문장 넣으면 IH 이상으로 들립니다.
12번에서 쓴 '막판 취소' 이야기와 연결하면 준비할 스토리가 줄어듭니다.

answers.IM3: Oh, that reminds me of something. Last spring, I planned a trip to Busan with my college friends. We booked the train and a hotel near Haeundae. But the day before the trip, a big typhoon came, and our train was canceled. We were really sad. So my friends came to my apartment, and we ordered chicken and watched movies all night. Two weeks later, we finally went to Busan. Yeah, that's my story about a canceled plan.
answers.IH: Oh, that reminds me of something that happened last spring. My college friends and I planned a weekend trip to Busan. We were all so busy at work, so we were really excited about it. We booked KTX tickets and a hotel near Haeundae Beach. But the night before the trip, a big typhoon came, and all the trains were canceled. At first, we were so upset. But I didn't want to waste the weekend, so I invited everyone to my apartment. We ordered fried chicken, watched comedy movies, and talked until three in the morning. It was actually really fun. Then I called the hotel and moved our booking to two weeks later. When we finally went, the weather was perfect, and the pork soup tasted even better. Yeah, that's how I handled a last-minute change.
answers.AL: Oh, that actually reminds me of something that happened last spring. A few of my college friends and I had been planning a weekend trip to Busan for months. We all have pretty busy jobs, so finding a weekend that worked for everyone was a real struggle. We finally booked KTX tickets and a cute hotel right near Haeundae Beach. But the night before we were supposed to leave, a huge typhoon hit the south coast, and every single train was canceled. Honestly, I was crushed, and our group chat was full of crying emojis. But instead of just giving up, I invited everyone over to my apartment. We ordered a ton of fried chicken, binge-watched comedy movies, and stayed up chatting until three in the morning. My little living room was totally packed, but it was one of the most fun nights I'd had in ages. The next morning, I called the hotel and the train company and moved everything to two weeks later. And when we finally made it to Busan, the weather was absolutely perfect. So in the end, the cancellation turned out to be a blessing in disguise. Yeah, that's how I dealt with a last-minute change of plans.

questions.en: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a problem with a ticket, a reservation, or something you bought? Tell me what the problem was and how you solved it.
questions.ko: 상황은 여기까지입니다. 표나 예약, 또는 산 물건에 문제가 생긴 적이 있나요? 어떤 문제였고 어떻게 해결했는지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Oh, I remember one time ~.' → 언제·어디서(작년 여름 Minji와 오사카) → 문제(호텔에 예약 기록이 없음) → 해결(확인 이메일 보여 주기, 다른 방 받음) → 'Yeah, that's ~.'
문제 상황의 감정(panicked, so tired)과 해결 뒤 감정(relieved)을 대비시키면 이야기가 생생해집니다.
AL은 '그 뒤로는 늘 확인 메일을 캡처해 둔다'처럼 배운 점으로 마무리하세요.

answers.IM3: Oh, I remember one time I had a problem with a hotel reservation. Last summer, I went to Osaka with my coworker Minji. We arrived at the hotel late at night. But the staff said they didn't have our reservation. I was so surprised and tired. So I showed them the confirmation email on my phone. They checked again and found the mistake. They gave us a different room. Yeah, that's how I solved the problem.
answers.IH: Oh, I remember one time I had a problem with a hotel reservation. Last summer, I went to Osaka with my coworker Minji for our vacation. Our flight was delayed, so we got to the hotel around eleven at night. We were exhausted, but the man at the front desk said he couldn't find our reservation. I started to panic a little, because it was so late. Then I remembered the confirmation email, so I showed it to him on my phone. He checked again and found that they had put the wrong date in their system. He said sorry many times, and he gave us a bigger room with a nice city view. We were so relieved. Since then, I always save my booking emails before I travel. Yeah, that's how I solved the problem.
answers.AL: Oh, I actually remember one time I had a pretty stressful problem with a hotel reservation. Last summer, my coworker Minji and I went to Osaka for our vacation. It was our first trip together, and we'd been looking forward to it for months. Unfortunately, our flight was delayed by two hours, so by the time we got to the hotel, it was almost midnight. We were completely exhausted and just wanted to crash, but the guy at the front desk told us he couldn't find our reservation anywhere. My heart sank, because I had no idea where we could go that late in a foreign city. But I tried to stay calm and pulled up the confirmation email on my phone. When he looked at it, he realized that someone had entered the wrong check-in date in their system. He apologized over and over, and to make up for it, he upgraded us to a bigger room with an amazing view of the city lights. Honestly, it ended up being even better than what we'd booked. Ever since then, I always take a screenshot of my reservations before a trip, just in case. So yeah, that's how I handled a problem with a booking.

pronunciation.tip: 명사는 앞 '리'에 강세. f는 윗니를 아랫입술에 대고
'캔슬드'처럼 두 음절. ed를 '에드'로 따로 읽지 않기
'메이'에 강세. f 발음을 p로 바꾸지 않기

patterns.en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new action movie this Saturday.
patterns.ko: 안녕하세요, 이번 주 토요일에 하는 새 액션 영화 때문에 전화드렸어요.

patterns.en: I'd like to know how much the tickets are for two people.
patterns.ko: 두 명이면 표가 얼마인지 알고 싶어요.

patterns.en: Is it possible to cancel the trip if something comes up at work?
patterns.ko: 회사에 일이 생기면 여행을 취소할 수 있나요?

patterns.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with my movie tickets for this Saturday.
patterns.ko: 죄송하지만 이번 주 토요일 영화표에 문제가 생겼어요.

patterns.en: How about changing both tickets to Sunday evening instead?
patterns.ko: 대신 두 장 다 일요일 저녁으로 바꾸는 건 어떨까요?

patterns.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could put us on a later flight on the same day.
patterns.ko: 같은 날 더 늦은 항공편으로 바꿔 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

patterns.en: Something unexpected happened when my college friends and I were about to leave for Busan.
patterns.ko: 대학 친구들과 부산으로 막 떠나려던 참에 예상치 못한 일이 생겼어요.

patterns.en: Since then, I always make sure to save my booking emails before I travel.
patterns.ko: 그 뒤로는 여행 전에 꼭 예약 확인 메일을 저장해 둬요.
